summary: Frontend-only testing of Casa Güell restaurant SPA. All requested corrections and new features verified successfully in Desktop (1920x1080) and Mobile (390x844). Corrections in 'Per Picar' tab (Torrezno de Sòria, Truita de Camarón, Terrina Cruixent d'Orella 14,50€) are correct. New 'Les Bogeries del Jordi' tab present with all 5 dishes and correct prices. Hover photo card works on desktop for dishes with images (verified with canelones). New 'El Mercat' section present with title, note, main image and 3 gallery images; nav-link-mercat scrolls correctly. Header no longer contains 'L'Equip' link. Language toggle CA/ES translates tabs and nav correctly ('Les Bogeries del Jordi' -> 'Las Locuras de Jordi', 'El Mercat' -> 'El Mercado'). Hero shows logo, phrase 'Tradició catalana, sense maquillatge' and both buttons; reserve opens CoverManager iframe drawer. Mobile viewport shows 1 visible hero video slot (others hidden), inline mobile image present for dishes with images, and no horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: MenuSection.jsx line 8 hardcodes FOOD_TABS - fine but keep in sync with content.js tabs.

Minor: Hero video slots query returned 4 elements matching data-testid^='hero-video-slot-'; spec mentions 0/1/2 (3 slots). Not a bug per protected context (H.264 codec unavailable in headless Chromium), but worth verifying slot count matches design intent (may include a 4th slot on desktop).
Minor: One 404 console error observed on initial page load (resource not identified in error). Non-blocking but should be investigated to avoid noisy console.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All previously requested features and corrections verified working on both desktop and mobile. Videos won't play in Playwright headless (H.264 codec) — do not report as bug. Hero has 4 video slot elements (not 3) — verify with product owner if needed.
